question.worked_solution:
The table shows probabilities in the form $P(X\ge x).$ So first, we express the desired probability in this form:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\ge x) & =1-P(X\le x) \\  & =1-0.9 \\  & =0.1\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since $X∼{T}_{19},$ we focus on the row of the table that corresponds to $k=19.$

| $k∖p$ | $0.100$ | $0.050$ | $0.025$ | $0.010$ | $0.005$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $19$ | $1.328$ | $1.729$ | $2.093$ | $2.539$ | $2.861$ |
| $20$ | $1.325$ | $1.725$ | $2.086$ | $2.528$ | $2.845$ |
| $21$ | $1.323$ | $1.721$ | $2.080$ | $2.518$ | $2.831$ |

From this row, we see that

$$
P(X\ge 1.328)=0.100.
$$

Therefore, our answer is $x=1.328.$
